auth.note: Handled globally by src/proxy.js + src/app/api/_lib/proxy.js. Never add auth headers per-route.

notes: This table's endpoints split across 2 real domains: connectors/pipeline are GENERIC (shared by sap|pnid|ts|docs, stage/connector-parameterized) and already lived in src/services/domain-configuration/common/ before this table was pasted.
Only getTsContext/patchTsRows/commitTsContext are genuinely timeseries-exclusive — these moved into a new src/services/domain-configuration/timeseries/timeseriesService.js.

getCommitHistory is generic (source=ts|docs|sap|pnid) and was previously duplicated: once in documents/documentsService.js (source='docs' default) and once dead in cdm/contextService.js as getContextCommits (0 callers). Consolidated into common/commitHistoryService.js per user decision 2026-07-14.

Old contextService.js's getTsContext/commitTsContext/patchTsRows used field name `plant_code` (not `plant_code_id`) and never unwrapped the {success,message,data} envelope — meaning `data.rows` in useTsFormState.js was reading the wrong level and always fell back to an empty list. Fixed as part of this migration.

endpoints.description: Upload timeseries files (CSV/XLSX/Parquet) to RustFS staging; file_type=values also ingests into IoTDB in background.
Run cloud connector (S3/ADLS/GCS) for timeseries files into RustFS.
Start a CDM pipeline stage (sap|pnid|ts|docs|full) asynchronously. stage='ts' for this domain.
Poll pipeline job status. Requires plant_code_id query param.
Cancel a running pipeline job. Requires plant_code_id query param.
Retrieve processed timeseries tag metadata for review.

upload_batch_id.note: Table row is internally inconsistent: the top URL, the Parameters list, and the response envelope all agree on `upload_batch_id`; only one illustrative request-example line uses `batch_id` (looks like a stale copy/paste — it also mixes a different plant code). Resolved to `upload_batch_id`, matching the already-confirmed getDocsContext convention.

endpoints.responseEnvelope: {success, message, data: {source, plant_code_id, upload_batch_id, scope, rows: [...]}}
endpoints.verdict: breaking (field rename + envelope was never unwrapped — real bug fix)
endpoints.oldServiceFn: cdm.getTsContext (removed) — used plant_code + batch_id, no unwrap
